beats.label: Predict
beats.narration: Predict how cooling affects condensation and rain.

beats.label: Observe
beats.narration: Adjust cooling. Condensation is limited by available vapour; rainfall needs droplet growth.

beats.label: Explain
beats.narration: Explain why invisible vapour can condense into visible cloud droplets without rain.

check.question: Can a visible cloud exist without rainfall?
options: Yes; droplets may not grow enough to fall.
No; condensation always leads to rain.
check.explanation: Clouds are tiny droplets or ice crystals; precipitation requires further growth and conditions.
